problem: What are the coordinates of the vertex of the parabola ${x}^{2}=5y?$

feedback.problem: What are the coordinates of the vertex of the parabola ${x}^{2}=6y?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The standard equation of an upward- or downward-opening parabola that has its vertex at the origin is

$$
{x}^{2}=4py,
$$

where $p$ is a constant.

We can rewrite the given equation as 

$$
{x}^{2}=4(\frac{3}{2})y.
$$

It is now clear that our equation is of the standard type with $p=\frac{3}{2}.$ Therefore, our parabola has its vertex at $(0,0).$
